name: Sam Loc Reward Bot

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_claims:
        description: 'So cycles moi session (roi dong browser)'
        default: '40'
      cooldown:
        description: 'Nghi giua cac claim (giay)'
        default: '3'
      rest_between_runs:
        description: 'Nghi sau khi dong browser truoc khi mo lai (giay)'
        default: '6'
      max_runtime:
        description: 'Tong thoi gian chay toi da (giay)'
        default: '19800'

jobs:
  claim:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 350
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      # Cache pip
      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: pip-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Cache Playwright browsers
      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-chromium
          restore-keys: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install deps
        run: |
          pip install playwright
          npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Run bot
        env:
          MAX_CLAIMS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_claims || '30' }}
          COOLDOWN: ${{ github.event.inputs.cooldown || '3' }}
          REST_BETWEEN_RUNS: ${{ github.event.inputs.rest_between_runs || '60' }}
          MAX_RUNTIME: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_runtime || '19800' }}
          HEADLESS: 'true'
        run: |
          echo "===== Cookie files tim thay trong repo ====="
          ls -la ck*.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "KHONG co file ck*.txt nao!"
          echo "============================================"
          python3 sam_reward_bot_v3.py

      - name: Screenshot on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: debug-screenshot
          path: /tmp/game_load_failed.png
          if-no-files-found: ignore
